notes.title: Major Update including all new art assets
notes.content:
Changelog for "Midnight at the Disco" - Major Update
Welcome to the most significant update ever for "Midnight at the Disco"! We've been hard at work to bring you a fresh, more engaging, and visually stunning experience. Here's what's new:

Visuals and Art

Complete Overhaul of Art Assets: We've revamped almost all art assets in the game, bringing a fresh look to the Disco. Everything has received a visual upgrade to enhance your experience.


Gameplay Enhancements

Revamped Skill Tree: Dive into a more complex and rewarding skill tree system. With the introduction of upgrade rarities, players can now customize their builds in more depth, allowing for unique combinations and strategies.

New Scoring System: Get ready to aim for higher scores with our newly implemented scoring system. This adds an extra layer of challenge and competition, encouraging players to refine their skills and strategies.


Quality of Life Improvements

QOL Enhancements: Based on your feedback, we've implemented numerous quality of life improvements to make your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable.

Optimizations: We've made several under-the-hood optimizations to improve game performance, ensuring a seamless experience.


Small Changes: Alongside major updates, we've made many small tweaks and adjustments to improve overall gameplay, interface usability, and more.

We believe these changes will significantly enhance your experience with "Midnight at the Disco." As always, we're eager to hear your feedback, so don't hesitate to reach out with your thoughts, suggestions, and any issues you might encounter.

Thank you for your continued support, and see you on the dance floor!
